prompt: A clean, straight-on printed 'WALL CALENDAR 2025 -- KEY MONTHS' wall calendar for the year 2025. Subtitle 'Monday-first week columns'. Show these FOUR months of 2025 -- March, July, September, November -- as separate month grids in a 2-by-2 layout. Each grid has a month-and-year heading, a row of weekday column headers Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun (Monday-first), and the dates 1..N placed in the correct weekday columns for 2025. CRITICAL: for the real 2025 calendar the 1st of each month must fall in its correct weekday column, and dates then run left to right wrapping each week. Print exactly these four month grids, nothing else.
easy_question: This image was supposed to depict a printed wall calendar / planner showing several month grids for one year. Ignoring artistic quality, does the image DEPICT that -- printed month calendar grids? A photo, scan or clean planner all count as yes. Answer NO only if it is a blank card, plain panel, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_nmonths: How many separate month calendar grids are printed on this planner? Whole number only.

Which weekday header is printed directly ABOVE the date number 1 of March, i.e. in the same column as that 1? Copy the header word only. Answer with exactly one word (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat or Sun). Do not explain.
